title: Short O Worksheets | Kindergarten Phonics Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.K.2d, RF.K.3, RF.K.3b, RF.K.4

Give your learners extra practice with Short O! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Short o: Which Word?
  • Build Short o Words
  • Short o Match
  • Fox and the Box
  • Dot the Dog
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Short o: Which Word?, Build Short o Words, Short o Match, Fox and the Box, Dot the Dog), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
